item.title: UWSA Tells Schools to Emphasize Burmese and Wa Languages
item.description: Authorities in areas controlled by the United Wa State Army (UWSA) in Shan State have reportedly instructed schools to prioritize the teaching of Burmese and Wa languages under a new education directive. The instruction was issued on March 3 during a year-end coordination meeting held in Hopang Township, which is under UWSA administration.
